title: VWP Fact
description: An extracted or computed observation supported by evidence. Facts are observations, not conclusions.

value.description: Optional structured value for the fact (number, string, boolean, or object).

evidenceRefs.description: IDs of evidence objects supporting this fact.

extractionMethod.description: How the fact was obtained, e.g. 'manual', 'deterministic-parser', 'model-extraction'.

extractionModel.description: When a model extracted this fact, the exact model used. Lets reviewers challenge model-extracted facts with a different model than the one that produced them.

name.description: Exact model identifier as published by the provider, not a family or marketing name.
